limitations: One selected main-frame tab, five link kinds (telephone, text, geo, foreign view and own private intent), current-tab identity, foreground and destruction. Handoff is atomic on Main; no fairness or liveness is claimed.

Five exact Robolectric cases execute production Android Intent construction and the production BrowserTabHostPlugin.handoff method, with actual WebView, controlled event/Android launch ports, selected/current/paused/dead/destroyed/no-gesture refusals and a host-resolved system link. Java and Kotlin production sources compile.

The abstraction admits only fixed DIAL/SENDTO/VIEW actions. It excludes URI parser completeness, all Android resolver behavior, physical handlers, WebView gesture attestation, popup-ticket provenance and full Capacitor lifecycle. No call or message send authority is modeled or exercised.
